Once again I am lost. I have no idea what I am doing. It seems as if every path leads to nowhere. I am moving in circles, with a destination in mind, but that destination has no real start or end. How I wish I could touch the thoughts and feelings of another. How I pray that one day things will be different. I do not mind death, Lord and un-Lord knows. I have no fear of dying, but the process is somewhat dizzying.

Why do any of us struggle? Why is the world set this way? I tire of the injustices that occur on every corner of this Earth. I am weary of trying to be a good person when all it leads to is being taken advantage of.

I'm not sure if any hope can be taken from this, but by and large, I had a very similar experience through most of my 20s. Nothing made sense. Everything seemed pointless. I considered suicide many many times. But with age also came perspective. Being able to look over my past, I see how all those terrible, bleak moments wove together to create a tapestry that now forms me. I now firmly believe that there is an unseen guidance in life that dictates the events we live. Even someone who dies a senseless death is considered part of a larger event which they contribute to.

My point is: don't give up. Call it God. Call it fate. Call it the tale and irony of life. But don't give up on the ride. Hindsight is 20/20, and looking back over your own story can be the most fascinating entertainment you will ever know.
